full_judgment: 10. With regard to obtaining expert opinion on the signature(s) as prayed for by the accused-petitioner, we hold that since the bank itself has not raised any objection to the acceptability or genuineness of the signature appearing in the dishonoured cheque, the presumption is that the signature was acceptable to the bank. So the burden lies on the accused-petitioner to prove that the signature is not genuine.
